notes: EXPERIMENTAL BASELINE (operator decision 2026-10-15: not approved, retouching suspended, kept with all evidence as the baseline of the hand-authored-grid method). It was aimed at the wrong reference: the operator's target is the '16 generic townsfolk' sheet (chibi proportions, about 45-48 art px tall, painted pixel-art look). Originally a Pass 4A gold-master candidate for Merchant District NPCs: canal porter (grain sack held by its tied neck, iron hook, knit cap, beard, linen shirt, indigo vest, leather shoulder pad, hemp rope harness, canvas leg wraps). 32x48 runtime format, front view (down), 4-frame idle (rest 700 / exhale 500 / rest 700 / blink 160 ms), 30 colours, Aseprite validate 100 Clean. Pixel grids authored and pushed live into Aseprite 1.3.18.6 through the aseprite-ai-artist 0.8.2 MCP server; eight revisions, three independent critic passes (5/10, 6/10, 7/10, then a verification of v8). Character Lab self-test 0 mismatch on cameras A-D (negative control fails). Shown in the running scene only through the dev-only ?labsprite preview; not used by the game. Approval and production use are operator decisions. Evidence: art-lab/characters/reviews/porter-gm-v1/, screenshots/4a/.
